payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed information about the current state-of-the-art speech recognition systems on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) dataset, including specific models and their performance metrics.

claims.text: The current best model on WSJ is an HMM-based system that combines convolutional, recurrent, and fully connected layers, achieving the lowest WER.
A fully convolutional approach has been developed that matches the current state-of-the-art performance on WSJ, processing raw waveforms directly.
Replacing traditional n-gram language models with convolutional ones has shown to improve WER, making the new model competitive with the best end-to-end systems.
